title: Restore Admin Verified Badge Control and Admin Message Access

requirements.text: Restore the Admin capability to assign the blue-tick “Verified” status to a selected user from the Admin user moderation UI, ensuring the control is visible and functional and that verification is reflected anywhere verified badges appear (profile, posts, stories, avatars).

quotes: Hat gaya hai , wapas lagani hai.

acceptanceCriteria: When an Admin selects a user in Admin > Users and clicks the Verified action, the backend successfully marks the user as verified and returns success.
After verifying a user, the Admin UI updates to show the user as Verified without requiring a full page reload.
Verified indicators (blue-tick) render consistently for that user wherever the app currently shows verified status (e.g., profile header/avatar overlays, post author rows, story headers).
Non-admin callers cannot invoke the verification action; the backend rejects the call with an authorization error.

requirements.text: Restore Admin “message access” by implementing an Admin-only, read-only view of a selected user’s conversations and message history in the Admin user management flow (replacing the current placeholder that says conversations cannot be viewed).

quotes: Blue tick ka verified badge dene wala admin ka se hat gya aur massage access karne Wala bhi wala bhi

acceptanceCriteria: In Admin > Users, after selecting a user, the “User Conversations” panel loads a list of that user’s conversations (read-only).
An Admin can open a conversation and view the message history (including text and stickers/media where applicable) in a read-only format.
The Admin cannot send, edit, or delete messages from this view (no compose UI, and backend prevents write actions for this feature).
Non-admin callers cannot fetch another user’s conversations/messages; the backend rejects the call with an authorization error.
If a user has no conversations, the panel shows an English empty state indicating there are no conversations to display.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo changes if an upgrade is required for state compatibility.

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui (compose instead).
All user-facing text introduced or changed by this request must be in English.
nonGoals: Implementing real-time messaging or live admin monitoring.
Allowing admins to send messages as a user or impersonate users.
Adding third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
